QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] Another One?!
QuestInfo.0: An unidentified vessel has appeared in the skies of Orbis. After the whole Black Heaven thing, people are understandibly freaked out. Go see if Kayla the Fairy needs some help.
QuestInfo.1: Kayla the Fairy is indeed freaked out about the strange ship in the sky over Orbis. She suspects that the witch Karula in Orbis has something to do with it.
